title: GitHub Trending Summary - Daily - 2026-10-11
ranking_basis: GitHub Trending daily stars gained, descending
ranking_explanation: Sorted the displayed "stars today" values from the daily Trending page; total stars and current default-branch commits were corroborated through the GitHub REST API.
global_caveat: A fast-moving daily snapshot; star gains measure attention, not quality, safety, maturity, or verified compatibility. REST totals were read after the Trending-page capture and may differ slightly as counts update.

themes.title: Agent-assisted reverse engineering

sections.title: Headline
sections.content: Agent-oriented tools lead today's list, but REA dominates the daily gain; creative-agent workflows and a major AnyPS5 spike are also prominent.

sections.title: morluto/rea
sections.description: Reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries.
sections.why_notable: Agent-based reverse engineering across applications, runtime behavior, and binaries.

sections.title: boykopovar/AnyPS5
sections.description: Tool for automatic PS5 executables porting to Linux and Windows
sections.why_notable: A high-momentum systems outlier; README describes native relinking and library implementations, not emulation.
sections.unique_caveat: Compatibility remains project- and game-specific; consult its tested compatibility list.

sections.title: storytold/artcraft
sections.description: ArtCraft is an intentional crafting engine for artists, designers, and filmmakers
sections.why_notable: README presents an IDE for interactive AI image/video work with scene composition and deliberate control.

sections.title: mattpocock/skills
sections.description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
sections.why_notable: Promotes small, adaptable, composable skills usable across models, rather than one rigid process.

sections.title: cathrynlavery/diagram-design
sections.description: Editorial diagram design for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Factory Droid, and Pi. 44 diagram types. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.
sections.why_notable: A design-oriented cross-agent skill producing standalone HTML/SVG diagrams; README says 44 diagram types.

sections.title: anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins
sections.description: Open source repository of plugins primarily intended for knowledge workers to use in Claude Cowork
sections.why_notable: An official plugin repository extending agents into knowledge-work use cases.

sections.title: hugohe3/ppt-master
sections.description: AI turns documents or topics into real, native PowerPoint decks—with native shapes, transitions and animations, data-backed charts and tables on demand, audio narration from speaker notes, and support for your own .pptx templates.
sections.why_notable: Turns source material into editable native PowerPoint decks with optional charts, transitions, and narration.

sections.title: multica-ai/andrej-karpathy-skills
sections.description: A single CLAUDE.md file to improve Claude Code behavior, derived from Andrej Karpathy's observations on LLM coding pitfalls.
sections.why_notable: A compact instruction-file approach to coding-agent behavior is seeing substantial daily attention.

sections.title: mksglu/context-mode
sections.description: Context window optimization for AI coding agents. Sandboxes tool output (98% reduction), persists session memory, and enforces routing across 17 platforms via MCP + hooks.
sections.why_notable: Targets context efficiency and tool routing for coding agents using MCP and hooks.

sections.title: huggingface/transformers
sections.description: 🤗 Transformers: the model-definition framework for state-of-the-art machine learning models in text, vision, audio, and multimodal models, for both inference and training.
sections.why_notable: A mature, broad model framework that supplies a counterpoint to the newer agent-specialist entries.

sections.title: Trending Technologies and Themes
sections.content: Agent skills/extensions: Matt Pocock Skills, Diagram Design, Knowledge Work Plugins, Andrej Karpathy Skills, and Context Mode. Creative and office production: ArtCraft and PPT Master. Reverse engineering and portability: REA and AnyPS5. Language tally across ten entries: Python 3, TypeScript 2, C++, Rust, Shell, and HTML 1 each; one unreported.
